Axiom:
**Scaffolding writes a MINIMAL skeleton; phase-subagent appends event lines as work happens.**
- **SKELETON** for Round 1 = under `### Round 1 — , initial`, one `#### P` block per phase declared in Phases Overview. It contains only semantic closing placeholders; successful STEP_5 inserts its structured receipt atomically: ``` #### P - [ ] `` DONE ``` No pre-filled `file` / `test` / `cov` / `rules` / `recon` / `sync` lines — those were noise (duplicated Target Files / Test Scenario Coverage / Rules: list / git diff). Event lines (`intro` / `decision` / `tried` / `discovery` / `insight` / `verified` / `BLOCKED`) are APPENDED by the phase agent only when the event actually happens. - **FACT** = the closing `[x]` lines have placeholders replaced with real values; preceding event lines exist only if their event happened. - Each phase block ends with `**Handoff →** artifacts: [...]; decisions: [...]; open: [...]` line. - Round closes with `#### Round close` block (single `DONE`) emitted by orchestrator after the last phase. - **Forbidden**: `[x]` line containing any unreplaced `<…>` literal = fabricated done. - Append-only by Rounds.
A trivial phase has one CLI-owned receipt, `DONE`, and Handoff. Event lines exist only when they carry information that is not elsewhere.
